rule: EXCEPTIONS_MATRIX.md R1 (binding, 2026-10-24): a side's age is its OLDEST MATERIAL INPUT (inputs_as_of), not its run time. It is superseded when older than min(14 d, 2 x its cadence): review 7 d, synthesis 14 d, curator 2 trading days, plan 7 d, quote per AGENTS.md 7A. Refresh is queued only to a producer that writes the compared input.
reader: scripts/lib/conflicts/producer_registry.py (annotate: cadence_days, writes_compared_input, inputs_as_of from the binding material)

CIO record.label: CIO stance (CIO prospect record and curator)
CIO record.writer: scripts/lib/cio_instrument_record.py (cio_prospect store) and the cio-prospect-shadow lane
CIO record.cadence_note: The curator passes every trading day. The canonical's own staleness is judged in trading days by R7b (2 and 10 trading days), not by this cadence.
CIO record.inputs_as_of: oldest weighted conviction_components[].evidence_at (scripts/lib/cio_truth.py _material_clock); the canonical's as_of already carries it

watchlist CIO review.label: CIO watch review
watchlist CIO review.cadence_note: Monday, Wednesday and Friday 16:20 ET; 2 x 3.5 d = the matrix's 7 d review limit.
watchlist CIO review.inputs_as_of: artifact inputs_as_of when the worker writes it; completed_at otherwise (the worker does not yet stamp its input snapshot time)

watchlist_final_synthesis.label: Watch desk synthesis
watchlist_final_synthesis.cadence_note: 2 x 7 d = the matrix's 14 d synthesis limit.
watchlist_final_synthesis.inputs_as_of: not exposed by the producer; updated_at is used
watchlist_final_synthesis.writes_compared_input_reason: Every process_watchlist_agent_jobs lane is RETIRED in config/lane_registry.json, so no running producer rewrites this row. A stale synthesis is shown as superseded and no refresh is queued to a producer that cannot run.

trade_ai.label: Trade AI checks
trade_ai.cadence_note: Weekly packet batch. Trade AI is a gate (R3), not a judgment side, except trade-state AVOID.

reentry_decision_desk.label: Re-entry desk
reentry_decision_desk.inputs_as_of: the binding material: the one furthest past its own limit (quote per AGENTS.md 7A in session time, plan 7 d)
reentry_decision_desk.writes_compared_input_reason: The desk state is computed on read; no lane writes it. Its materials are refreshed by their own owners (quotes by the quote writer, plans by the entry planner).

plan.label: Entry plan
plan.cadence_note: 2 x 3.5 d = the matrix's 7 d plan limit.

quote.label: Canonical quote
quote.cadence_note: Limit = config/data_source_authority.json quote_price stale_after_hours, measured in session time (a closed market does not age a quote taken at or after the last close).
